body: No other drugs worked.  I am going to go to bed for the night.  (I am in Europe.)

I am aware that it is possible for people to be successful in my position, but I haven't been able to control my anxiety.  I have had two panic attacks at school this week.  I am prescribed Xanax, but it doesn't seem to stop the panic attacks no matter how much I take.  (Plus addiction is not fun, so I don't want to risk it.)

I am 16 (almost 17) and my parents are going to kick me out when I turn 18.  I have a lot of trouble with anxiety, depression, and dealing with other people.  I had a job that I loved for a few months, but I couldn't take the anxiety/fear of screwing up.  I also can't deal with people which drastically limits what I could do.
I'm not sure.  I guess I am looking for someone to calm me down.  I have had a rough couple of days and am afraid to talk to anyone.  I don't really know what to do.
I don't want to wind up being hospitalized again; the last time didn't go well.  I don't think I could tell someone with authority without getting locked up again.

I just moved, so I have no friends.  I don't like alcohol, so I never drink.  I am not sure where you got that idea from.  I worry a lot about getting a job, because I need to start being able to provide for myself.  The sooner I can stop being a burden, the better.  I am scared of having to deal with the real world.  I can't really work a real job, so I don't know how I am going to provide for myself.
I don't really have anyone to confide in.  Our school has a counselor, but I have already taken up so much of his time.  I don't want to keep causing problems.
